siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Subtiel
siblings.summary: Eight hotels and B&Bs within a ≤20-min walk of Subtiel (Westhoeklaan 31), ranked by distance, with the picks for closest, best heritage charm, and best beachfront.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Subtiel
siblings.summary: Seven characterful stays for a Subtiel weekend — Dumontwijk Belle-Époque villas you can walk back to, plus a 1725 Veurne farmhouse-B&B and a dune-side boutique hotel a short taxi away.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Subtiel
siblings.summary: Subtiel sits at Belgium's western tip — within 30 km it's blue-economy maritime tech (Oostende) and the Dunkerque French Tech ecosystem. No general-purpose dev conferences.
